title: Novel Complex of Zinc (II) Dichloroethylenediamine: Synthesis, Characterization, In-silico, and In-vitro Evaluation against Cervical Cancer Cells.
authors: Raya, Indah; Kartina, Desy; Wijaya, Ronald Ivan; Irfandi, Rizal; Abdalrazaq, Eid A; Prihantono, Prihantono; Santi, Santi; Pratiwi, Eka; Khaerunnisa, Andi Besse; Luthfiana, Dewi; Musa, Bulkis; Natsir, Hasnah; Maming, Maming; Zainuddin, Zaraswati Dwyana; Ramlawati, Ramlawati; Fudholi, Ahmad; Usman, Andi Nilawati; Supratman, Unang; Mazaya, Maulida; Sufiandi, Sandi
journal: Asian Pacific journal of cancer prevention : APJCP
one_liner_zh: 该研究合成锌配合物并通过分子对接和MD模拟考察其与DNA的结合，虽属蛋白-DNA互作外的小分子-DNA体系，但对接与MD方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Cervical cancer is a malignancy originating from the cervix and often caused by oncogenic Human Papilloma Virus (HPV), specifically subtypes 16 and 18. Anticancer drugs are chemotherapeutic compounds used for cancer treatment. Therefore, this research aims to synthesize and characterize Zinc (II) dichloroethylenediamine (Zn(en)Cl2) complex, as well as determine its antiproliferative activity against HeLa cells. The Zn(en)Cl2 complex was successfully synthesized, and the antiproliferative activity was tested. METHODS: The synthesis involved reacting ethylenediamine and KCl with Zn metal. The complex formed was characterized using a conductometer, UV-Vis spectroscopy, FT-IR spectroscopy, and XRD, while the activity was measured against HeLa cells. RESULT: The synthesis yielded a 56.12% conversion with a melting point of 198-200 oC and a conductivity value of 2.02 mS/cm. The Zn(en)Cl2 complex showed potential activity against HeLa cells with an IC50 value of 898.35 microg/mL, which was evidenced by changes in the morphological structure of HeLa cells. Its interaction with DNA targets was investigated by employing molecular docking. CONCLUSION: The observed data indicated that the Zn(en)Cl2 complex bound to DNA at the nitrogenous base Guanine (DG) by coordinate covalent bonds. Interestingly, DG maintained interaction with the complex until the end of the docking simulation. Additionally, molecular dynamics (MD) simulation was conducted, and the results showed that Zn(en)Cl2 remained bound to the DNA binding pocket all through the process.
abstract_zh: 目的：宫颈癌是一种起源于宫颈的恶性肿瘤，常由致癌性人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）引起，特别是16和18亚型。抗癌药物是用于癌症治疗的化疗化合物。因此，本研究旨在合成并表征锌（II）二氯乙二胺（Zn(en)Cl2）配合物，并测定其对HeLa细胞的抗增殖活性。成功合成了Zn(en)Cl2配合物，并测试了其抗增殖活性。方法：合成过程涉及将乙二胺和KCl与Zn金属反应。形成的配合物使用电导仪、紫外-可见光谱、傅里叶变换红外光谱和XRD进行表征，同时针对HeLa细胞测定其活性。结果：合成产率为56.12%，熔点为198-200 oC，电导值为2.02 mS/cm。Zn(en)Cl2配合物对HeLa细胞显示出潜在活性，IC50值为898.35微克/毫升，这通过HeLa细胞形态结构的变化得到证实。其与DNA靶标的相互作用通过分子对接进行了研究。结论：观察数据表明，Zn(en)Cl2配合物通过配位共价键与DNA的含氮碱基鸟嘌呤（DG）结合。有趣的是，DG在整个对接模拟过程中一直与配合物保持相互作用。此外，进行了分子动力学（MD）模拟，结果显示Zn(en)Cl2在整个过程中始终与DNA结合口袋保持结合。
